purpose: Mavacamten is used to treat a heart condition called obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), where the heart muscle becomes too thick and makes it harder for blood to flow out of the heart. It helps relieve symptoms like shortness of breath, chest pain, and dizziness that come with this condition. It is meant for adults whose symptoms are not well controlled.
how_it_works: Your heart muscle squeezes using tiny proteins called myosin. In HCM, too many of these proteins are active at the same time, making the heart squeeze too hard and become stiff. Mavacamten calms down some of that extra activity, helping the heart relax and pump blood more normally and efficiently.
common_side_effects: Dizziness or lightheadedness, especially when standing up. Some people also experience tiredness or fatigue. Heart failure symptoms such as increased shortness of breath or swelling can sometimes occur, so it is important to report any new or worsening symptoms to your doctor right away.
warnings: This medication can weaken the heart's pumping function, so your doctor will monitor your heart with regular echocardiograms (heart ultrasounds). You should NOT take it if you are pregnant, as it can harm an unborn baby — effective birth control is required. It interacts with many common medications and supplements, so always tell every healthcare provider about all medicines you take. Because of serious risks, this medication is only available through a special restricted program called the Camzyos REMS Program.
typical_dosing: You usually start at a low dose of 2.5 mg taken by mouth once daily. Your doctor will check your heart function regularly and may slowly adjust your dose up or down based on how your heart responds. Never change your dose or stop taking it without talking to your doctor first.
